scope: VoiceTranslationLanguageDetector direct-buffer and native retirement ownership only; no network, recognition confidence, language-pair or playback policy change.

fix.ownership: Process-owned registry admits independent healthy owners. Each verified direct ByteBuffer is registered before SDK task creation and retained with its backend until successful close.
fix.failure: Uncertain SDK create or close retains all still-admitted owners and seals future admission before any later model allocation. A failed close is never retried; healthy existing owners may continue and release normally.
fix.concurrency: No single-owner limit or arbitrary active-owner cap. SDK task creation, inference and close stay on the existing per-detector workers outside the registry lock.
fix.verification_lock: The bounded local asset read/digest/direct-buffer allocation and MediaPipeJniContract.verify occur under admission lock; verify performs Java reflection with initialize=false and does not call JNI.
fix.privacy: No source text, predictions or model contents are logged or sent to a network.

primary_source.qualification: Official current source corroboration; not represented as the exact Maven native build source revision.

model.model_card_review: Page 1 declares Apache License 2.0 and authors; page 2 expressly excludes multilingual-text accuracy guarantees.

pinned_boundary_findings: BaseOptions.Builder requires a direct or mapped ByteBuffer.
BaseOptionsUtils.createExternalFileFromBuffer serializes direct address plus position and remaining length.
Exact x86_64 JNI nativeGetDirectBufferAddress tail-calls JNIEnv entry 230 (GetDirectBufferAddress); no copied model or JNI global owner is created at this boundary.
LanguageDetector retains TaskRunner; TaskRunner fields retain no BaseOptions, TaskInfo, or ByteBuffer owner.
TaskRunner.close marks graphStarted=false before closing/waiting on native graph; a later retry can return without proving cleanup.
native_source_corroboration: ExternalFileHandler returns pointer metadata as an absl::string_view without copying or owning the original allocation.
ModelResources passes that same data pointer to FlatBufferModel::VerifyAndBuildFromBuffer.
limits: Static bytecode and JNI disassembly, not Android JNI inference or physical hardware execution.
No mapping from current native-source blob to the Maven native build is asserted.

new_regressions: Two healthy owners coexist and retire independently; repeated successful close is harmless.
Model verification failure before JNI does not seal future admission.
Native creation exception or linkage failure retains the borrowed model and blocks later model/native allocation.
Native close exception or linkage failure retains buffer/backend, prevents close retry, seals new admission, and lets already-admitted healthy owners retire.
In-flight native close retains its buffer without holding the registry lock or blocking another healthy owner.
final.retention_test_note: Weak-reference tests assert positive retention after a GC request; none depend on a collector reclaiming a released object. Deterministic registry counts and callback counters verify retirement/admission ordering.
final.native_backend: Explicit injected fake backend for lifecycle and policy behavior. Actual Android SDK/MediaPipe artifacts used for compilation; production_stubs=[]
final.known_warning: Existing MediaPipeJniContract java.util.List reflection warning; no new compile warnings.

limitations: This is actual-source host compilation and fake-backend lifecycle testing, plus static pinned API/JNI inspection. It is not Android JNI inference, an APK test, or physical GPU/NPU qualification.
The existing real Linux language-model fixture receipt uses a different host MediaPipe version and is not upgraded into Android runtime proof by this change.
Official current C++ source corroborates pointer-backed model borrowing; no exact source revision mapping to the Maven native build is asserted.
The canonical fast gate, full Android lint/compilation, source metadata refresh and publication remain owned by the root integration task. No gates were bypassed.
